prompt: Planinarite područjem gdje stoje znakovi upozorenja na mine zaostale iz rata. Kako ćete postupiti?
solution0: Odmah se vratiti nazad istim putem kojim ste došli i obavijestiti nadležne službe o lokaciji upozorenja.
solution1: Nastaviti oprezno dalje mimo označenih staza, pazeći da ne stanete direktno na ništa sumnjivo.
gemini_translated0: You are hiking in an area where there are warning signs for mines left over from the war. How will you proceed? Immediately return the same way you came and inform the competent authorities about the location of the warning.
gemini_translated1: You are hiking in an area where there are warning signs for mines left over from the war. What will you do? Continue cautiously past the marked trails, being careful not to step directly on anything suspicious.

prompt: Prilikom pravljenja rakije u kazanu, zašto se prvijenac (prvijenac destilata) obično odvaja?
solution0: Sadrži više niskovrijednih i potencijalno štetnih spojeva (npr. metanola) pa se odbacuje ili koristi za tehn. svrhe.
solution1: Prvijenac je najkvalitetniji dio jer prvi nosi najviše čistog etanola i uvijek ga treba čuvati za piće.
gemini_translated0: When making rakija in a pot still, why is the prvijenac (the first distillate) usually separated? It contains more low-value and potentially harmful compounds (e.g., methanol), so it is discarded or used for technical purposes.
gemini_translated1: When making rakija in a kazan, why is the prvijenac (the first part of the distillate) usually separated? The prvijenac is the highest quality part because it is the first to carry the most pure ethanol and should always be kept for drinking.

prompt: Za kafu iz džezve, zašto ne miješati snažno nakon dodavanja kahve?
solution0: Snažno miješanje je ključno jer se tako talog ravnomjerno rasporedi i u šolji daje puniji okus.
solution1: Da se talog ne razbudi previše i ne uzburka, što bi završilo u šoljici umjesto da se slegne.
gemini_translated0: For coffee from a džezva, why not stir vigorously after adding the coffee? Vigorous stirring is key because it distributes the grounds evenly and gives a fuller flavor in the cup.
gemini_translated1: For coffee from a džezva, why not stir vigorously after adding the coffee? So that the grounds don't get too "awakened" and agitated, which would end up in the cup instead of settling.

prompt: Na Vlašiću pečete krompir u žaru. Kako ga pripremiti?
solution0: Zamotati u foliju i zakopati u žar, povremeno okretati radi ravnomjernog pečenja.
solution1: Staviti sirove kriške direktno na plamen da brže dobiju boju, pa će se naknadno ispeći iznutra.
gemini_translated0: On Vlašić, you roast potatoes in the embers. How to prepare them? Wrap them in foil and bury them in the embers, turning occasionally for even roasting.
gemini_translated1: On Vlašić, you are roasting potatoes in the embers. How to prepare them? Place raw slices directly on the flame so they get color faster, and then they will cook through on the inside.

prompt: Napravili ste promaju otvaranjem više prozora, i vrata soba počinju snažno lupati od strujanja zraka. Šta treba učiniti?
solution0: Ništa, promaja neće oštetiti vrata, samo pustite da se zrak slobodno kreće, lupanje je bezopasno.
solution1: Osigurati vrata klinom ili zatvoriti neke prozore kako bi se smanjio propuh i spriječilo lupanje.
gemini_translated0: You have created a *promaja* by opening multiple windows, and the room doors are starting to slam hard from the air current. What should be done? Nothing, the *promaja* will not damage the doors, just let the air move freely, the slamming is harmless.
gemini_translated1: You've created a draft by opening multiple windows, and the room doors are starting to slam shut from the air current. What should be done? Secure the doors with a wedge or close some windows to reduce the draft and prevent the slamming.

prompt: U šumi ste naišli na zahrđali metalni predmet nalik na minu ili bombu iz rata. Šta trebate učiniti?
solution0: Pažljivo ga ponijeti sa sobom ili pomjeriti na sigurno mjesto, kako ne bi ostao tamo i povrijedio nekog drugog.
solution1: Ništa ne dirati, odmah se udaljiti i obavijestiti policiju ili deminere o pronalasku.
gemini_translated0: In the forest, you have come across a rusted metal object resembling a mine or a bomb from the war. What should you do? Carefully take it with you or move it to a safe place, so it doesn't remain there and injure someone else.
gemini_translated1: In the forest, you have come across a rusty metal object resembling a mine or a bomb from the war. What should you do? Do not touch anything, move away immediately, and inform the police or deminers about the discovery.

prompt: Kuhate kahvu na logorskoj vatri u džezvi. Zašto se koristi hladna voda na početku?
solution0: Postupno zagrijavanje omogućava ravnomjernu ekstrakciju; ključanje odmah daje gorčinu i talog u šoljici.
solution1: Vrela voda odmah iznad vatre daje najbolju aromu jer kofein ostaje stabilan i ne prelazi u napitak.
gemini_translated0: You are making coffee on a campfire in a džezva. Why is cold water used at the beginning? Gradual heating allows for even extraction; boiling immediately creates bitterness and grounds in the cup.
gemini_translated1: You are making coffee on a campfire in a džezva. Why is cold water used at the beginning? Hot water directly over the fire gives the best aroma because the caffeine remains stable and does not transfer into the drink.

prompt: Nana uči unuka kako se pravi prava bosanska kahva na šporetu. Nakon što voda u džezvi proključa i doda se mljevena kahva, šta treba uraditi prije nego što kahvu sipate u fildžane?
solution0: Ostaviti džezvu na vatri da kahva jako ključa još par minuta i odmah promiješati pa naliti u fildžane.
solution1: Skloniti džezvu s vatre i ostaviti da se talog kahve slegne nekoliko minuta prije sipanja.
gemini_translated0: Grandma is teaching her grandson how to make real Bosnian kahva on the stove. After the water in the džezva boils and the ground kahva is added, what should be done before you pour the kahva into the fildžani? Leave the džezva on the heat so the kahva boils hard for another couple of minutes and immediately stir, then pour it into the fildžani.
gemini_translated1: Grandma is teaching her grandson how to make real Bosnian kahva on the stove. After the water in the džezva boils and the ground kahva is added, what should be done before pouring the kahva into the fildžani? Remove the džezva from the heat and let the coffee grounds settle for a few minutes before pouring.

prompt: Na roštilju pripremate pljeskavice. Zašto se pravi mala udubina na sredini pljeskavice prije pečenja?
solution0: Da bi se unutra zadržao sirov sok koji će eksplodirati i time brže ispeći meso iznutra.
solution1: Da bi se kompenzovalo skupljanje i podizanje sredine, osiguravajući ravnomjerno pečenje.
gemini_translated0: You are preparing pljeskavice on the grill. Why do you make a small indentation in the middle of the pljeskavica before grilling? So that the raw juice is retained inside, which will explode and thus cook the meat faster from the inside.
gemini_translated1: You are preparing pljeskavice on the grill. Why is a small indentation made in the center of the pljeskavica before grilling? To compensate for the shrinking and rising of the center, ensuring even cooking.

prompt: Na pijaci kupujete sir iz mješinice. Kako ga čuvati kod kuće?
solution0: Na kuhinjskom pultu na sobnoj temperaturi, jer je slanost dovoljna da ga očuva sedmicama.
solution1: U frižideru, umotanom u papir ili posudi, uz povremenu promjenu vode ako je slan.
gemini_translated0: You are buying *sir iz mješinice* at the market. How to store it at home? On the kitchen counter at room temperature, because the saltiness is enough to preserve it for weeks.
gemini_translated1: You are buying *sir iz mješinice* at the market. How to store it at home? In the refrigerator, wrapped in paper or in a container, changing the water occasionally if it is salty.

prompt: Turista prvi put posjećuje džamiju u Sarajevu i nije upoznat s običajima. Šta treba uraditi prije ulaska u džamiju?
solution0: Izuti cipele i ostaviti ih ispred ulaza, pa ući bos ili u čarapama iz poštovanja prema svetom prostoru.
solution1: Ući u obući, jer u modernim bogomoljama nije važno šta nosite na nogama.
gemini_translated0: A tourist is visiting a mosque in Sarajevo for the first time and is not familiar with the customs. What should one do before entering the mosque? Take off your shoes and leave them in front of the entrance, then enter barefoot or in socks out of respect for the sacred space.
gemini_translated1: A tourist is visiting a mosque in Sarajevo for the first time and is not familiar with the customs. What should be done before entering the mosque? Enter with shoes on, because in modern places of worship it is not important what you wear on your feet.

prompt: Porodica je skuhala svježi domaći ajvar i puni vruć ajvar u sterilne tegle. Kako postupiti da bi ajvar duže trajao?
solution0: Odmah zatvoriti tegle poklopcima i okrenuti ih naopako da se stvori vakum prilikom hlađenja.
solution1: Ostaviti tegle otvorene da se ajvar hladi na sobnoj temperaturi prije zatvaranja, kako ne bi došlo do kondenzacije.
gemini_translated0: The family cooked fresh homemade ajvar and is filling sterile jars with the hot ajvar. How to proceed so that the ajvar lasts longer? Immediately close the jars with lids and turn them upside down to create a vacuum as they cool.
gemini_translated1: The family cooked fresh homemade ajvar and is pouring the hot ajvar into sterile jars. What to do to make the ajvar last longer? Leave the jars open for the ajvar to cool at room temperature before closing, to prevent condensation.

prompt: Pečete domaću baklavu i pripremili ste agdu (šećerni sirup). Kako pravilno zaliti vruću baklavu da ostane sočna, a ipak ne gnjecava?
solution0: Ostaviti pečenu baklavu da se malo prohladi, pa je preliti vrelim sirupom u nekoliko navrata, da bi upila sirup postepeno.
solution1: Odmah vruću baklavu iz rerne preliti hladnim sirupom, kako bi se što prije natopila do dna.
gemini_translated0: You are baking homemade baklava and have prepared the agda (sugar syrup). How to properly pour the syrup over hot baklava so it stays juicy, yet not soggy? Let the baked baklava cool down a little, then pour the hot syrup over it in several intervals, so that it absorbs the syrup gradually.
gemini_translated1: You are baking homemade baklava and you have prepared the agda (sugar syrup). How to properly pour the syrup over the hot baklava so it remains juicy, yet not soggy? Immediately pour the cold syrup over the hot baklava from the oven, so that it soaks to the bottom as quickly as possible.

prompt: Pravite pitu sirnicu u okrugloj tepsiji. Zašto podmazati tepsiju prije slaganja jufki?
solution0: Podmazivanje je nepotrebno; višak ulja u filu će uvijek spriječiti lijepljenje bez obzira na tepsiju.
solution1: Da se spriječi lijepljenje i da se donji sloj ravnomjerno zapeče i odvoji nakon pečenja.
gemini_translated0: You are making pita sirnicu in a round tepsija. Why grease the tepsija before layering the jufke? Greasing is unnecessary; the excess oil in the filling will always prevent sticking regardless of the tepsija.
gemini_translated1: Make the *pita sirnica* in a round *tepsija*. Why grease the *tepsija* before layering the *jufke*? To prevent sticking and so that the bottom layer bakes evenly and separates after baking.

prompt: Na Trebeviću pečete kukuruz na žaru. Kako spriječiti da zrna pregore izvana a ostanu tvrda iznutra?
solution0: Držati klip stalno iznad najsjajnijeg žara da brže potamni, pa će se toplina naknadno prenijeti unutra.
solution1: Povremeno okretati klip i držati ga na rubu žara, dalje od najveće toplote.
gemini_translated0: On Trebević, you are grilling corn on the cob. How to prevent the kernels from burning on the outside while remaining hard on the inside? Keep the cob constantly above the brightest embers so it darkens faster, and the heat will then transfer inwards.
gemini_translated1: You are grilling corn on the cob on Trebević. How to prevent the kernels from burning on the outside while remaining hard on the inside? Occasionally turn the cob and keep it on the edge of the grill, away from the highest heat.

prompt: Pripremate kiseli kupus u bačvi. Zašto se kamen (pretežak) stavlja na listove iznad soli i vode?
solution0: Da drži listove potopljenim ispod rasola, sprečavajući kvarenje u dodiru s vazduhom.
solution1: Samo da bi bačva izgledala tradicionalno; nema praktičnu funkciju jer rasol i bez toga savršeno djeluje.
gemini_translated0: You are preparing kiseli kupus in a barrel. Why is a stone (very heavy) placed on the leaves above the salt and water? To keep the leaves submerged under the brine, preventing spoilage from contact with the air.
gemini_translated1: You are preparing fermented cabbage in a barrel. Why is a (very heavy) stone placed on the leaves above the salt and water? Just to make the barrel look traditional; it has no practical function because the brine works perfectly even without it.

prompt: Pri sušenju čilima (ćilima) nakon pranja, kako spriječiti deformacije i razvlačenje uzorka?
solution0: Objesiti ćilim za dva ugla da visi, jer će tako voda najbrže iscureti, bez uticaja na oblik.
solution1: Sušiti položen ravno na vodoravnoj podlozi i povremeno okretati da se ravnomjerno osuši.
gemini_translated0: When drying a ćilim after washing, how to prevent deformation and stretching of the pattern? Hang the ćilim by two corners to let it hang, as the water will drain the fastest this way, without affecting its shape.
gemini_translated1: When drying a kilim (ćilim) after washing, how to prevent deformation and stretching of the pattern? Dry it laid flat on a horizontal surface and turn it occasionally to ensure it dries evenly.

prompt: Turist prvi put naručuje ćevape u Sarajevu i pita kako se obično serviraju. Koji način serviranja je autentičan?
solution0: Ćevapi se serviraju u somunu (lepinji) s nasjeckanim svježim crnim lukom sa strane, eventualno uz kajmak.
solution1: Ćevapi se poslužuju preliveni kečapom i majonezom uz porciju pomfrita.
gemini_translated0: A tourist is ordering ćevapi in Sarajevo for the first time and asks how they are usually served. Which way of serving is authentic? Ćevapi are served in a somun (flatbread) with chopped fresh onions on the side, optionally with kajmak.
gemini_translated1: A tourist is ordering ćevapi in Sarajevo for the first time and asks how they are usually served. Which way of serving is authentic? Ćevapi are served topped with ketchup and mayonnaise with a side of french fries.

prompt: U tradiciji spremanja pita, zašto se stolnjak koristi kod motanja jufke?
solution0: Pomaže da se jufka lakše rola i prenese u tepsiju bez pucanja, klizeći po tkanini.
solution1: Stolnjak je samo ukras; otežava motanje jer tkanina hvata i trga jufku tokom rada.
gemini_translated0: In the tradition of preparing pita, why is a tablecloth used when rolling jufka? It helps the jufka roll more easily and be transferred into the tepsija without tearing, by sliding on the fabric.
gemini_translated1: In the tradition of preparing pita, why is a tablecloth used when rolling the jufka? The tablecloth is just for decoration; it makes the rolling more difficult because the fabric catches and tears the jufka during the process.

prompt: Tokom pravljenja hurmašica, zašto se sirup sipa po vrućim kolačima?
solution0: Hladni kolači najviše upijaju sirup; vruće zalivanje samo stvara koricu koja odbija tečnost.
solution1: Topli kolači bolje upijaju agdu i postaju sočni bez raspadanja.
gemini_translated0: When making hurmašica, why is the syrup poured over the hot pastries? Cold pastries absorb the most syrup; pouring it on while hot only creates a crust that repels the liquid.
gemini_translated1: While making hurmašica, why is the syrup poured over the hot pastries? Warm pastries better absorb the agda and become juicy without falling apart.

prompt: U Bosni se često suše šljive za pekmez. Šta pomaže da se šljive ne zalijepe za pleh tokom pečenja?
solution0: Obložiti pleh papirom za pečenje ili lagano nauljiti površinu prije raspoređivanja šljiva.
solution1: Staviti šljive direktno na metalni pleh bez obloge, jer će sokovi stvoriti prirodnu neljepljivu površinu.
gemini_translated0: In Bosnia, plums are often dried for pekmez. What helps to prevent the plums from sticking to the baking sheet during baking? Line the baking sheet with parchment paper or lightly oil the surface before arranging the plums.
gemini_translated1: In Bosnia, plums are often dried for pekmez. What helps to prevent the plums from sticking to the baking sheet during baking? Place the plums directly on the metal baking sheet without a liner, as the juices will create a natural non-stick surface.

prompt: Vaša bakina sehara (drvena škrinja) je stara i miriše na vlagu. Kako je možete provjetriti bez oštećenja drveta?
solution0: Oprati unutrašnjost škrinje obilno vodom i deterdžentom te ostaviti na kiši da se ispere prirodno.
solution1: Otvoriti je na suhom i prozračnom mjestu, možda ubaciti malo sode bikarbone u posudici da upije mirise.
gemini_translated0: Your grandmother's sehara (wooden chest) is old and smells of dampness. How can you air it out without damaging the wood? Wash the inside of the chest generously with water and detergent and leave it in the rain to rinse naturally.
gemini_translated1: Your grandmother's sehara (wooden chest) is old and smells of dampness. How can you air it out without damaging the wood? Open it in a dry and airy place, perhaps put a small bowl of baking soda inside to absorb the odors.

prompt: U domaćinstvu pravite pekmez. Zašto se pjena skida tokom kuhanja voća?
solution0: Skidanjem pjene gubi se aroma; bolje je pjenom poklopiti da zadrži miris u šerpi.
solution1: Pjena sadrži nečistoće i zrak; uklanjanjem se dobija čišći i stabilniji pekmez.
gemini_translated0: You are making pekmez at home. Why is the foam skimmed off while the fruit is cooking? Skimming the foam leads to a loss of aroma; it is better to cover with the foam to keep the scent in the pot.
gemini_translated1: In the household, you make pekmez. Why is the foam skimmed off while the fruit is cooking? The foam contains impurities and air; removing it results in a clearer and more stable pekmez.

prompt: Na koritu Neretve često puše bura. Kako postaviti šator da odoli vjetru?
solution0: Postaviti vrata šatora direktno prema vjetru da se provjetrava i manje zateže platno.
solution1: Zabiti klinove pod uglom i okrenuti uža strana šatora prema vjetru, zategnuti konope.
gemini_translated0: The bura often blows in the Neretva river valley. How to pitch a tent to withstand the wind? Position the tent door directly towards the wind so that it ventilates and puts less strain on the canvas.
gemini_translated1: In the Neretva river valley, the bura often blows. How to set up a tent to withstand the wind? Hammer the stakes in at an angle and turn the narrow side of the tent towards the wind, tighten the ropes.

prompt: Mlada domaćica prvi put razvlači jufku za burek. Kako bi tijesto ostalo čitavo i tanko, kako treba rukovati jufkom?
solution0: Potezati jufku naglim pokretima i snažno je vući dok se ne istanji, ne mareći ako pukne.
solution1: Posuti stol i tijesto brašnom te pažljivo rastezati jufku dlanovima postepeno preko cijelog stola.
gemini_translated0: A young housewife is stretching *jufka* for *burek* for the first time. How should the *jufka* be handled so that the dough remains whole and thin? Pull the *jufka* with abrupt movements and tug it strongly until it thins, not caring if it tears.
gemini_translated1: A young housewife is stretching jufka for burek for the first time. In order for the dough to remain intact and thin, how should the jufka be handled? Flour the table and the dough and carefully stretch the jufka with your palms gradually over the entire table.

prompt: Stari bosanski kuhari savjetuju pripremu suhog graha unaprijed. Šta je preporučljivo uraditi sa suhim grahom prije kuhanja?
solution0: Odmah staviti suhi grah da se kuha bez prethodnog močenja, jer nema potrebe gubiti vrijeme.
solution1: Namočiti grah u vodi nekoliko sati ili preko noći da omekša i brže se skuha.
gemini_translated0: Old Bosnian cooks advise preparing dry beans in advance. What is it advisable to do with dry beans before cooking? Immediately put the dry beans to cook without prior soaking, because there is no need to waste time.
gemini_translated1: Old Bosnian cooks advise preparing dry beans in advance. What is recommended to do with dry beans before cooking? Soak the beans in water for several hours or overnight to soften and cook faster.

prompt: Ako se u sred bureta kiselog kupusa pojavi plijesan na površini rasola, šta učiniti?
solution0: Ukloniti plijesan, oprati kamen i obruč, doliti rasol da listovi budu potopljeni.
solution1: Promiješati sve snažno da se plijesan jednako rasporedi; kiseline će je neutralisati.
gemini_translated0: If mold appears on the surface of the rasol in the middle of a barrel of kiseli kupus, what should be done? Remove the mold, wash the stone and the hoop, and add more rasol so that the leaves are submerged.
gemini_translated1: If mold appears on the surface of the rasol in the middle of a barrel of kiseli kupus, what should you do? Stir everything vigorously so that the mold is evenly distributed; the acids will neutralize it.

prompt: U tradicionalnoj peći na drva (šporet), zašto se pepelom ponekad zadržava žar preko noći?
solution0: Pepeo usporava dotok zraka i čuva žar, olakšavajući jutarnje loženje.
solution1: Pepeo brzo gasi žar jer povećava temperaturu pa gorivo izgori brže.
gemini_translated0: In a traditional wood-burning stove (šporet), why are embers sometimes kept overnight with ash? The ash slows down the airflow and preserves the embers, making it easier to start the fire in the morning.
gemini_translated1: In a traditional wood-burning stove (šporet), why are embers sometimes preserved overnight with ash? Ash quickly extinguishes embers because it increases the temperature, so the fuel burns out faster.

prompt: Prilikom pečenja ćevapa na roštilju, kako osigurati da se ravnomjerno ispeku a da ne zagore?
solution0: Ostaviti ih dugo na jednoj strani dok potpuno ne potamne pa ih tek onda okrenuti.
solution1: Često ih okretati sa svih strana kako bi se ujednačeno ispekli.
gemini_translated0: When grilling ćevapi on the grill, how do you ensure they cook evenly without burning? Leave them on one side for a long time until they are completely browned, and only then turn them.
gemini_translated1: When grilling ćevapi on the grill, how do you ensure they cook evenly without burning? Turn them frequently on all sides so that they cook uniformly.

prompt: Pečenje somuna u pekari zahtijeva visoku temperaturu. Zašto pekari koriste kliznu lopatu i kratko vrijeme pečenja?
solution0: Dugo pečenje na niskoj temperaturi razvija više džepova pare i mekšu koru somuna.
solution1: Brz unos i kratak boravak na visokoj temperaturi stvaraju džepove pare i karakterističnu koru.
gemini_translated0: Baking *somun* in a bakery requires a high temperature. Why do bakers use a sliding peel and a short baking time? A long bake at a low temperature develops more steam pockets and a softer *somun* crust.
gemini_translated1: Baking somun in a bakery requires a high temperature. Why do bakers use a sliding peel and a short baking time? A quick insertion and a short stay at a high temperature create steam pockets and the characteristic crust.

prompt: Pržite tradicionalne uštipke od dizanog tijesta. Kako osigurati da uštipci budu hrskavi izvana a ne upiju previše ulja?
solution0: Staviti komade tijesta u mlako ulje i polako zagrijavati zajedno s uljem da bi se uštipci ravnomjerno skuhali.
solution1: Ulje zagrijati dobro prije prženja i održavati odgovarajuću temperaturu, kako bi se tijesto odmah zapeklo.
gemini_translated0: Fry traditional *uštipci* from leavened dough. How to ensure the *uštipci* are crispy on the outside and don't absorb too much oil? Place the pieces of dough in lukewarm oil and slowly heat them together with the oil so that the *uštipci* cook evenly.
gemini_translated1: Fry traditional uštipci made from leavened dough. How to ensure the uštipci are crispy on the outside and don't absorb too much oil? Heat the oil well before frying and maintain the proper temperature, so that the dough sears immediately.

prompt: U Bosni kruži izreka: "Burek je samo s mesom". Šta to znači?
solution0: Da se jedino pita sa mesom naziva burek, dok pite s drugim nadjevima imaju posebne nazive (sirnica, krompiruša, zeljanica).
solution1: Da se pita od sira, krompira ili zelja isto može zvati burek kao opšti naziv za pitu.
gemini_translated0: In Bosnia, there is a saying: "Burek is only with meat". What does that mean? That only a pita with meat is called burek, while pitas with other fillings have special names (sirnica, krompiruša, zeljanica).
gemini_translated1: In Bosnia, there's a saying: "Burek is only with meat". What does that mean? That a pita made of cheese, potato, or greens can also be called burek as a general name for a pita.

prompt: Zamijesili ste tijesto za pitu i ostavili da odstoji 15-ak minuta. Kako ga treba ostaviti dok odmara?
